frozen_selected_acquisitions.role: deeper raw support tracking processed Acceptl28-33

source_exact_semantics.bath_quality_semantics: number of good beams; negative if ping rejected
source_exact_semantics.beam_quality: report raw byte only; no invented threshold

stage_A_ping_ancillary.selection: only frozen selected ping/beam identifiers; no new geometry or depth selection

stage_B_svp.selection_per_family: latest preserved SVP datagram at or before each selected ping time; if none exists before a ping in the accessible archive, report NONE rather than borrowing a future profile

predeclared_diagnostic_logic.SVP_OR_SOUNDVEL_DIFFERENCE_SUPPORTED: line18-era and line32-era selected pings bind to different preserved SVP profiles or materially different recorded surface sound velocity; report exact difference without claiming it causes the 186-191m depth split
predeclared_diagnostic_logic.ATTITUDE_OR_MODE_DIFFERENCE_SUPPORTED: selected families differ in bath mode/resolution or show materially different roll/pitch/heave fields; diagnostic association only
predeclared_diagnostic_logic.NO_OBVIOUS_ANCILLARY_DIFFERENCE: profiles and recorded ancillary fields are similar; mechanism remains unresolved
predeclared_diagnostic_logic.MISSING_PROVENANCE: required SVP or parameter provenance absent from accessible raw archive
